featured.title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
featured.tldr: Kandinsky 6.0 Video releases open MIT-licensed 3B and 29B models that generate five-second clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio and lip-sync, competitive with leading closed and open systems, especially on speech.

featured.title: YuE2: Unifying Symbolic and Audio Music Generation at Frontier Quality
featured.tldr: YuE2 writes a readable score first, then renders a full song from it with one model, earning expert preference over the same model without planning and rivaling commercial generators on some measures.
